records.title: Reverse-proxy operator relies on req.protocol/req.secure
records.actor: backend developer behind a TLS-terminating proxy
records.expected_outcome: req.secure correctly reflects HTTPS so HTTPS-only middleware behaves.

records.title: Developer sets a short-lived cookie
records.actor: app developer setting a flash/CSRF cookie with maxAge
records.expected_outcome: the cookie lives for the requested duration, not expiring instantly.

records.title: API returns a redirect with a custom status
records.trigger: a 3xx status outside the common set
records.expected_outcome: a clean, human-readable redirect body — never the literal undefined.

records.title: Client consumes a JSONP endpoint
records.expected_outcome: a safe text/javascript payload invoking only a validly-named callback.

records.title: Client negotiates content with quality params
records.actor: HTTP client sending Accept with q= and media-type params
records.expected_outcome: parameters (including quoted values) parsed per RFC 7231.

records.title: String body with a pre-set charset
records.trigger: res.send(string) with a pre-set non-utf-8 charset
records.expected_outcome: documented, consistent charset behavior for string bodies.

records.title: Buffer body with a pre-set charset
records.actor: developer sending Buffer.from('é','latin1') with a latin1 Content-Type
records.trigger: res.send(Buffer) with a pre-set non-utf-8 charset
records.expected_outcome: charset behavior consistent with the string-body rule, or explicitly specified divergence.

records.title: Charset set via res.set/res.type then send
records.actor: developer setting the type via res.type('html') then res.send
records.expected_outcome: mime.contentType injection and setCharset injection agree.

records.title: Trusted X-Forwarded-Host with a normal authority
Trusted X-Forwarded-Host with a leading/trailing comma
records.actor: app behind a proxy that concatenates forwarded hosts
records.expected_outcome: hostname resolution never silently returns undefined for a present host.

records.title: X-Forwarded-Host carrying a port or IPv6 literal
records.actor: app behind a proxy forwarding host:port or [::1]:port
records.expected_outcome: the port is stripped to a clean hostname.
